summary: This is a routine 6-K filing of quarterly financial results by Valneva SE. The issuer reports Q1 2026 financials, adjusting 2026 product sales guidance to $135-150M from $145-160M, and announces a restructuring plan to reduce global workforce by 10-15% and operating expenses 25-35%. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or shareholder vote is involved. The restructuring is a cost-cutting initiative, not a special-situation event warranting a classification category. The filing is a standard earnings release with guidance revision.
